title: Afternoon observability jot + followups
content:
Quick afternoon dump — inbox triage while waiting on Ella's perf patch review. Mostly scratchy, action items and short repros so I don't forget later.

Context:
- Prod US-EAST observability console: some dashboards intermittently failing to render (blank tiles) for a subset of customers. Reports started 10:30am, alert noise ramped ~11:05.
- Customer impact: customers seeing "No data" tiles on Route Monitoring and Token Usage dashboards; API calls succeed but dashboards show empty series.
- Hypothesis: ingestion lag or query timeouts at the metrics-query service (rq-metrics) after the recent deployment. Could also be a dashboard filter mismatch (timepicker granularity) combined with stale index.

Today focus (priority order):
1) Confirm whether metrics ingestion is delayed or queries timing out.
2) Narrow to customers and dashboards affected.
3) Patch fix or mitigation (dashboard fallback, extend query timeout, add note to customers).

Immediate checklist (done / todo):
- [x] Pull logs for rq-metrics from 10:00-12:00 in prod-us-east-1 (log-id: logs-20260312-rq). Observed 504s between 10:58-11:12.
- [x] Check deployment changelog -> rolled instrumentation v2.1.9 at 10:45 (PR #678).
- [ ] Reproduce blank tile in incognito with a seeded test customer (cust: dev-echo-17).
- [ ] Try increasing grafana datasource timeout for affected dashboards to 30s (temp).
- [ ] Add a short-run playbook note for CS: "If dashboard blank, check rq-metrics error rate and restart query node".

Short repro steps (notes to self):
1) Login as dev-echo-17 (impersonate) -> open Console > Observability > Route Monitoring.
2) Time window: last 1h, refresh. If tile blank, check network waterfall -> grafana query returns 504 or empty array.
3) curl to metrics API: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://metrics.prod.redwood.example/v1/query?query=route_latency_p99&start=<ts>&end=<ts>"
4) If API returns 500/504, tail rq-metrics logs: kubectl -n prod logs -l app=rq-metrics --since=30m.

Observed artifacts / snippets:
- Recent error excerpt: "ERROR: fetchSeries timeout after 15s -> upstream 504" (multiple nodes).
- PromQL used on Route Monitoring tile: sum(rate(route_request_count[5m])) by (route) 
- p99 latency metric: route_latency_p99{env="prod"} (spike 11:00-11:10)

Hypotheses (ranked):
A) Regression from instrumentation v2.1.9 -> causes heavier cardinality in queries -> queries exceed 15s timeout. (most likely)
B) Autoscaler for metrics-query pods failed to spin up under burst -> queueing/timeouts.
C) Grafana dashboard timepicker edge case with 1m granularity + now-1h causing empty series for some customers (less likely given logs).

Short-term mitigations to try now:
- Bump metrics service query timeout from 15s -> 30s (config map change) and rollout to a single node group for testing.
- Revert instrumentation roll for rq-ingest if PR review shows cardinality bug.
- Add temporary dashboard note indicating data lag; CS message template ready.

Who to ping / next steps:
- Ping Ella for quick review on revert plan (she owns PR #678). Slack: @ella (link above).
- Assign JIRA RI-2345 to Ryan for autoscaler check (ryan to validate HPA events).
- I will run a controlled timeout bump on staging first, then prod if green (ETA: 30m).

Follow-ups (tracking):
- [Due 2026-03-14] Deep root-cause writeup (Omar) including query traces, pod metrics, promql adjustments.
- [Due 2026-03-13] Add dashboard guardrail: if query returns empty for 3 consecutive refreshes show last-known snapshot. (work item for dashboard team).

Notes to self / stray ideas:
- Consider adding a small pre-aggregation for high-cardinality tags (customer_id) to reduce on-the-fly cardinality explosion for p99 queries. Not trivial but would reduce tail latency.
- Could add a "fallback snapshot" feature in Console that shows last successful snapshot with a time annotation. Low effort UI flag.
- Add unit test / load test for promql expressions that are used in top 20 dashboards (catch cardinality regressions).

Random snippets (copy/paste later):
- kubectl -n prod get hpa -l app=rq-metrics -o yaml | grep -A3 metrics
- curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://metrics.prod.redwood.example/v1/query_range?query=route_latency_p99&start=...&end=...&step=15s" | jq '."data".result'

Customer threads / CS notes:
- CS reported: "Customer X sees Route Monitoring blank since 10:55AM, their routes are fine via API." Ticket: RI-2345. CS suggested temporary note in console banner.
- Draft banner: "We are investigating intermittent dashboard rendering issues. Data collection and API remain functional — we expect visual updates to return shortly. Contact support with ticket RI-2345 for updates."

End-of-scratchpad todos for this session (in order):
1) Attempt staging timeout bump -> validate with dev-echo-17.
2) Ping Ella + Ryan and post short summary to #observability.
3) If staging looks good, apply to prod for single node group and monitor 15m.
4) Draft CS banner and post in ticket.

-- omar
(last quick save; will polish into proper incident note if we have reproduction)
